functions.name: ASK
functions.description: Sends a prompt to your AI model in MIAI and shows the answer in the cell.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: What the model should do. Text or a cell.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The cell or range the prompt is about.

parameters.name: optimized
parameters.description: TRUE = fast, short answer without web search and thinking. Use it for many rows. Default is FALSE.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model name or a cell containing it. Omitted = the model from Settings.

functions.name: MODELS
functions.description: Lists the models on your endpoint in MIAI, one per row.
